command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; git fetch origin --prune; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $head=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); $origin=(git rev-parse origin/main).Trim(); Write-Output "HEAD_BEFORE=$head"; Write-Output "ORIGIN_MAIN=$origin"; if($head -ne $origin){throw 'main moved before Known Folder commit'}; git diff --check; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; git add -- app/winui/MainWindow.xaml.cpp app/winui/file_detail_controller.cpp app/winui/file_list_state.h app/winui/helper/FlyShellIsolationHelper.cpp src/base/shell_assoc_type_core.cpp src/base/shell_assoc_type_core.h tests/winui/test_known_folder_artwork_contract.py; git diff --cached --check; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Write-Output 'STAGED_PRODUCT'; git diff --cached --stat; git commit -m "ui: add Known Folder artwork"; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $product=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); Write-Output "PRODUCT_COMMIT=$product"; $env:PRODUCT_COMMIT=$product; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'review_known_folder_policy.py'; @'

import os,re
from pathlib import Path
product=os.environ["PRODUCT_COMMIT"]
p=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer\.agent-policy\PROJECT.md")
text=p.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig")
text,count=re.subn(r'"reviewed_revision": "[0-9a-f]{40}"',
                   f'"reviewed_revision": "{product}"',text,count=1)
if count!=1:
    raise RuntimeError("reviewed_revision replacement failed")
nl="\r\n" if "\r\n" in text else "\n"
anchor=nl.join([
"Large Icons is now an accepted fifth view mode (stable value 4) with private",
"preference/session persistence, a 64 px Shell visual path and bounded image",
"thumbnail use. Pre-main owned GUI evidence measured fully visible items at",
"112x128 with 120x132 pitch against the controlled Explorer Large Icons",
"baseline of 105x131 with 118x132 pitch; owned thumbnails were visible,",
"the GUI exited 0 and protected user settings remained unchanged.",
""])
if anchor not in text:
    raise RuntimeError("Large Icons policy anchor missing")
addition=anchor+nl.join([
"File-list Known Folder artwork now resolves Desktop, Documents, Downloads,",
"Pictures, Music and Videos through a fixed-key, disposable Shell helper path.",
"The detail worker matches OS Known Folder paths off the UI thread, the helper",
"returns bounded pixels, and generic folder artwork remains the fallback.",
"Pre-main before/after evidence changed all six targeted rows from generic",
"folder icons to their native Windows artwork with process exit 0.",
""])
text=text.replace(anchor,addition,1)
p.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))
print("POLICY_REVIEWED_REVISION",product,flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Remove-Item $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; git add -- .agent-policy/PROJECT.md; git diff --cached --check; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; git commit -m "policy: review Known Folder artwork"; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $policy=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); Write-Output "POLICY_COMMIT=$policy"; Write-Output 'STATUS_PRE_PUSH'; git status --short; git push origin main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; git fetch origin --prune; $headAfter=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); $originAfter=(git rev-parse origin/main).Trim(); Write-Output "HEAD_AFTER=$headAfter"; Write-Output "ORIGIN_AFTER=$originAfter"; if($headAfter -ne $originAfter){throw 'HEAD != origin/main after push'}; Write-Output 'KNOWN_FOLDER_MAIN_PUSH_PASS'
